findings.message: L114: 🔴 bug: Lambda captures `merging_nodes` by reference, so all tasks will use the final value. Use `functools.partial` or a default argument: `lambda nodes=merging_nodes: ...`.

L442: 🟡 risk: `settings.docStoreConn.delete` is likely a blocking I/O call; running it inside an async nursery without offloading to `trio.to_thread.run_sync` will block the event loop. Already partially wrapped but missing the outer wrapper; ensure the call is fully offloaded.

L204: 🔴 bug: `list.extend()` returns `None`; `sorted(set(None))` will crash. `node0_attrs["source_id"].extend(...)` must be called before sorting: `node0_attrs["source_id"].extend(node1_attrs.get("source_id", [])); node0_attrs["source_id"] = sorted(set(node0_attrs["source_id"]))`.
L215: 🔴 bug: Same `extend()` returns `None` issue for `edge0_attrs[attr]`. Must call `extend` first then assign `sorted(set(...))`.
